I, Gayantha Karunatilleke, Minister of Lands and ParliamentaryReforms, do hereby declare, under Sub-section (1) of Section 5 of theLand Acquisition Act, that the land described below is neededfor a public purpose and will be acquired under the provisions ofthat Act.

The allotments of land depicted in the Advance Tracing No. Co/KDW/2017/34 dated 13.11.2017, prepared by the Surveyor-General,situated in the Village of Thalangama North (within the MunicipalCouncil limits of Kaduwela) in the Grama Niladhari DivisionNo. 477-A of Thalangama North B in the Divisional Secretary’sDivision of Kaduwela in Colombo District in Western Province andbounded as follows:

01. Lot No. 1 – Dombagahawatta – Extent: 0.1374 HectareNorth: Dombagahawatta claimed by Road Passenger TransportAuthority and New Kandy Road; East: New Kandy Road,Road (R.D.A.) and Lot No. 2; South: Lot No. 2 and Dombagahawatta
claimed by Road Passenger Transport Authority; West:Dombagahawatta claimed by Road Passenger Transport Authority.

02. Lot No. 2 – Dombagahawatta – Extent: 0.0861 HectareNorth: Lot No. 1 and Road (R.D.A.); East: Road (R.D.A.) andDombagahawatta claimed by Road Passenger Transport Authority;South: Dombagahawatta claimed by Road Passenger TransportAuthority; West: Dombagahawatta claimed by Road PassengerTransport Authority and Lot No. 1.
Gayantha Karunatilleke,Minister of Lands and Parliamentary Reforms.
